messages:
Priya: quick follow up from the PM: we need durable ownership for test follow-ups. minimal plan below.
Oscar: share the plan.
Priya: plan: 1) tag PMs with 'requires-eval' at postmortem close, 2) auto-create issue RD-<id>-eval, 3) owner assigned in 48h, 4) prompt/regression/load/chaos type, 5) eval PR in 7d, nightly gating once merged. chaos drill if 2 recurrences in 30d.
Marta: suggest extracting 8 example prompts from logs to bootstrap promptsets. less friction.
Priya: agree. add a small tool to sanitize/extract prompts; tag @eng-ml for a quick ship.
eval-bot: RD-3333 eval PR created for incident-517  running nightly. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/3333
Oscar: can SRE own triage for the first 3 days then handoff to ML? balances load.
Priya: that's the rotation we envisioned. I'll update the issue template to include handoff steps and rollback plan.
Marta: also add 'recurrence watch' label so ops gets notified automatically.
Priya: will do. trial period 30d, owners update status every 3 days.
Oscar: ok. I'll take RD-3333.
Marta: I'll prototype the prompt-extract script this week and open a PR.
Priya: thanks all, closing out.
